comment: Every movement of money, one entry each. Amounts in whole cents (usd_cents) and whole naira (ngn). status is example, pending, sent or received; only sent and received count as real. goal ties an entry to goals.json so progress can be computed. receipt names a file in receipts/ once there is one. The entry below is an example of the shape and is never shown as real.
